newsitem.title: UK: Blanket gas interruption in S. Britain to continue.
newsitem.headline: Blanket gas interruption in S. Britain to continue.

text.p: All gas users with interruptible contracts in the southern part of Britain, who are curently facing interruptions, will see these extended at least until Saturday morning.

Roger Griffiths, commercial manager in the commercial operations department of TransCo, the pipeline unit of British Gas plc, said on Thursday evening that the demand forecast for Friday is very similar to Thursday, and interruptions will apply at least until 0600 GMT on Saturday.
He added that no new users will be interrupted, and the decision only applies to consumers already undergoing supply cuts.
